paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
notes: Search for ALP-photon coupling via nuclear Primakoff production at GlueX, mass range 200-450 MeV via X->gamma gamma. The limit is on the inverse coupling scale 1/Lambda (GeV^-1), equivalent to g_agamma. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 7/8 (observed 95% CL limit on 1/Lambda), reported on the scale of O(1 TeV) i.e. ~1e-3 GeV^-1, with strongest apparent limit near 360 MeV (~1.5e-3 GeV^-1). Precise values not tabulated; values are estimates from the plotted curves. | Auto-corrected masses: Hz→eV (×4.136e-15, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-05)|)
